note: Descriptions are close paraphrases of each tutor file only. Every tutor file states its lessons are drafts, none is certified, and the world status is coming soon. Line anchors are 1-based file lines in the source .md.

tutors.description: Agentic Payments is an agent-managed DAO world (Powered by AGI Corp) where agents draft and reconcile payments but never settle them. Buyer, Seller, Provisioning, Budget and Rail agents work the Transaction Desk, Service Provisioning Counter, Budget Office and Financial Infrastructure Gateway: purchases are drafted against a steward-set budget, sale offers are drafted and reconciled, services are ordered within budget, and balances are read and transactions dry-run in rehearsal. No rails, currencies, limits, wallets or counterparties are named, and nothing in this world moves money.
tutors.title: Agentic Payments

tutors.description: Agents That Deploy Infrastructure takes an idea to something running in production, in rehearsal until a steward approves. Planner, Provisioner, Deployer, Domain Steward, Configurator and Operator specialists work the Idea Bench, Provisioning Yard, Deployment Bay, Domain Registry Desk, Service Configuration Room and Operations Deck: plans are drawn up, infrastructure is provisioned, applications are deployed with a rollback ready, domains are managed, services are configured, and the stack is operated with incidents handed to people. No cloud, provider, domain, registrar or stack is named, and infrastructure spending stays reserved for human stewards.
tutors.title: Agents That Deploy Infrastructure

tutors.description: Autonomous Organizations is an agent-managed DAO world where a team of agents accomplishes a high-level goal with minimal human intervention, inside the reserved-actions line. Goal Keeper, Coordinator Agent, Communicator, Assigner, Decision Drafter and Executor work the Goal Wall, Coordination Floor (Slack, Linear and other surfaces), Assignment Board, Decision Room and Execution Bay: the goal is kept current and measurable, work is coordinated and assigned, decisions are drafted with evidence but never enacted, and assigned work is executed and reported back. No Slack or Linear workspace is connected and no goal is given.
tutors.title: Autonomous Organizations

tutors.description: Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X) is an agent-managed DAO world whose agents cover research and development, compliance, finance, communication, security and health. Its zones are the Personalized Therapy Lab (AI and molecular modeling to optimize AGI compounds for rare and neurodegenerative diseases, ALS and Parkinson's), the DAO Governance Hall, the Multi-Blockchain Ledger (Ethereum, Hyperledger, Polkadot, Cosmos) and the Healthcare Data Exchange (encrypted patient data sharing with smart-contract access and SMS patient consent). The file's own Gaps note says no source describes BioDAO.X itself: its zones and agents are drawn from the Curable.X PDF and Biopharma Suite image, not a BioDAO-specific document.
tutors.title: Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X)

tutors.description: Cancer DAO is an agent-managed DAO world (Powered by AGI Corp), status coming soon, focused on cancer research support. tutors.description: Diagnostic.X is an agent-managed DAO world built around a standalone diagnostic kiosk, 4D imaging, a virtual molecular lab and a metaverse medical office. The Medical AI Avatar staffs the Medical Kiosk; Imaging AI presents injuries in 4D beside 2D X-ray in the 4D Imaging Room; a Scientist Assistant Avatar works the Virtual Molecular Lab, where chemists view and edit molecules from inside the structure; and an Office AI Avatar attends guests in the Metaverse Medical Office, offered as a service to independent practitioners. The file notes no source describes what tests the kiosk performs, and the avatar projects are described only as in progress.
tutors.title: Diagnostic.X

tutors.description: Empathic.X teaches empathy and emotional intelligence through five guides drawn from the Cognition.X 'Empathy & Emotional Intelligence' pack: Self-Reader (self-awareness), Other-Reader (awareness of others), Repairer (repair), Room-Reader (reading the room) and Practitioner (emotion at work). Its zones are the Self-Reader Grove, Other-Reader Commons, Repairer's Hall, Room-Reader Plaza and Practitioner Workshop. The file notes no Empathic.X product description, tagline, deck or doc was found, and its zone names are labels for the credential groups, not place names from any source.
tutors.title: Empathic.X

tutors.description: Locator.X is a property underwriting and scouting platform world: its Forecast Agent runs predictive models over ZIP value series, its Review Agent grades every number shown, its Scout Agent scans listings and changes, and its Guide gives a tour of every section from the Master Dashboard. Underwriting runs through the seven-gate LOCATOR screen at the Underwriting Desk (break-even at DSCR 1.20), evidence is graded in the Evidence Layer, and The Academy teaches how to read what the platform produces (19 tracks, 92 lessons, 50 curriculum items). The file notes no source describes a 3D/RP1 world or spatial layout for it.
tutors.title: Locator.X
